report.title: {Items.Count} {Plural(Items.Count, 'application depends', 'applications depend')} on a package that no longer exists

messages.businessImpact: The installation cannot proceed, so the application fails on every device with no obvious cause in its own error message.
remediation: Restore the dependency package, or remove the dependency and handle the prerequisite another way.
messages.cannotSee: Dependencies are read one application at a time, so an application whose relationships this run could not read is not judged. Intune removes a relationship when the application it points at is deleted, so what this finds is a chain pointing at a package outside the applications this run read rather than at one that never existed.
